hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | { read -r f; case "$f:$PWD" in *product-context.yaml:*/.feature-workspaces/*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"CONCURRENCY PROTOCOL: Workspace sessions must not write to product-context.yaml. Write to .dev-workflow/signals/status.json instead. Only the main session (via /aep-wrap, /aep-dispatch, /aep-reflect) updates the YAML."}}' ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | { read -r cmd; case "$PWD" in */.feature-workspaces/*) if printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+(add|commit).*product-context\.yaml'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"CONCURRENCY PROTOCOL: Workspace sessions must not commit product-context.yaml. Write to .dev-workflow/signals/status.json instead."}}'; fi ;; esac; }
